stem: What can the reader conclude based on information in both paragraphs 2 and 8?

options.label: A
options.text: Milkweed that the monarchs depend on is a threat to farmers’ crops.

options.label: B
options.text: Monarchs are beginning to rely on food sources other than milkweed.

options.label: C
options.text: Migrating monarchs are often unable to find the milkweed they need.

options.label: D
options.text: Milkweed is more available in the United States than it is in Mexico.
